title: S3 ACC Platform Roles and Permission Boundaries

entries.name: Information Manager
entries.boundary: Overall CDE architecture, information security, archive write-lock enforcement, and technical validation of submission configuration. Platform capability does not itself assign ISO 19650 task-team approval-for-sharing, lead-appointed-party authorization, appointing-party acceptance, or supplementary milestone/handover authority.

entries.name: Project BIM Manager
entries.boundary: Operational coordination governance, assigned TIVERIT coordination decision functions, model promotion, and /02 administration. Promotion capability or Project Administrator access does not itself assign task-team approval for sharing, lead-appointed-party authorization, appointing-party acceptance, milestone approval, or handover acceptance responsibility.

entries.name: CDE Manager
entries.boundary: Technical provisioning, onboarding, group assignment, permission audits, platform configuration, and execution of authorized state transitions where assigned. Technical execution shall not be treated as the underlying ISO 19650 review/decision responsibility.

entries.name: Project BIM Coordinator
entries.boundary: Coordination spaces, issue creation/assignment, clash verification, and coordination evidence within assigned scope. Workflow participation does not itself assign task-team approval-for-sharing, lead-appointed-party authorization or appointing-party acceptance responsibility.

entries.name: Discipline Lead
entries.boundary: Own-discipline WIP administration and controlled package sharing within assigned project responsibility. Where ISO 19650 applies, any task-team approval-for-sharing responsibility shall be established by the applicable project appointment/governance and shall not be inferred solely from sharing capability or the Discipline Lead title.

entries.name: Model Author
entries.boundary: Own-discipline WIP authoring only; no ISO 19650 approval, authorization or acceptance responsibility is inferred from upload, edit, sync, issue or transition capability.

entries.name: Main Contractor Representative
entries.boundary: Published consumption plus submittal/RFI interfaces per BEP and applicable project instruments. Access to Published information does not itself identify the actor performing lead-appointed-party authorization or appointing-party acceptance and does not establish unrestricted reliance.

entries.name: Client Representative
entries.boundary: Published/transmittal review and record access per BEP and applicable project instruments. Viewer/reviewer access or the Client Representative title does not itself establish appointing-party acceptance responsibility; the project appointment/governance shall identify the responsible actor.

permission_authority_rule: Platform roles and permissions govern technical capability only. Where ISO 19650 applies, responsibility shall be resolved from the applicable ISO activity and party/function through the project appointment and information-management arrangements to the actual project actor. TIVERIT supplementary decisions shall be resolved separately through their governing project instruments.
transition_execution_rule: Where a user or automation executes a CDE state transition, the transition shall remain traceable to the required ISO 19650 review/decision evidence. The technical transition actor may differ from the task-team, lead-appointed-party or appointing-party actor responsible for the underlying activity.

provenance.migration_note: Three distinct governed functions retain Project Administrator capability. ISO-IMP-005 re-audit replaces generic TIVERIT authorization/acceptance abstractions with the applicable ISO 19650 task-team approval-for-sharing, lead-appointed-party authorization and appointing-party acceptance responsibilities. Platform capability overlap does not imply role equivalence or decision responsibility; project-role mapping remains required.
